decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the core geospatial stack and upgraded to its own web page in 2024, it reflects visible commitment and strategic fit, which under escalation-of-commitment logic makes withdrawal unlikely absent clear failure signals.

Although it was only still mentioned rather than strongly featured in 2024, it is a 2023 product line with several models and close to the firm's established offer, so prior investment and portfolio relevance still favor continuing it.

Its own page in 2024, strong adjacency to the firm's enterprise GIS integration work, and the firm's public direction toward broader system integration all support retaining it despite any early-market uncertainty.

As a 2024 consulting workshop that directly builds on the firm's established advisory business and was given its own page immediately, it requires relatively limited incremental resources and is likely to be kept while management gives it more time.
